Heater control (advanced)

Uses the heater only, and only in Independent mode. Kp and Ki turn the gap between the beer and its setpoint into a duty cycle, capped at 50 %, so the heater always rests at least as long as it heats. The duty is delivered as one pulse whose length is learned: after every pulse the heater stays off while the slow filter is watched for the peak, then the next pulse is rescaled so the beer rises about the number of sensor steps set below. Far below the setpoint a pulse stops early and lets the stored heat coast the beer up, and the heater is always cut at setpoint + 0.25 degC. A pulse never exceeds 300 s. The cooler is unchanged.

One sensor step is 0.0625 degC on a DS18B20. Keep it at 1 step unless the probe is finer. The minimum heat time and idle time from Advanced Settings are floors; the maximum heat time can only shorten a pulse, and no pulse exceeds 300 s.
